profile.name: Joenel Raytana
profile.title: Full Stack Developer
profile.summary: Full-stack developer with 9 years of experience in Application Development. Strong front-end background with 6+ years of pure Angular development, plus full-stack experience with Angular + Node.js + SQL and cloud deployments.

experience.overview: Performed backend development: creating APIs and batch processes.
Performed front-end tasks: designing, developing, fixing bugs, coordinating with back-end developers, testing, and maintaining technical documentation.
Designed and developed front-end solutions for McDO HR web application using ServiceNow Portal. Collaborated with back-end developers and aligned portal workflows.

Supported an electric company in optimizing and maintaining web applications for tracking and managing customer electric consumption. Led front-end development and optimization, hosted and integrated via GCP.

Developed and designed client mobile web applications focusing on chat and bulletin features. Led the front-end team and implemented mobile WebView development for seamless integration and performance.

Designed and developed Melco applications used by client administrators to manage activities. Collaborated with back-end developers, optimized performance, and ensured responsive cross-platform compatibility.

Contributed to initiatives that enhance employee experience and streamline internal processes. Key projects: Onboarding Web App, Pesh (AngularJS → Angular 10 upgrade), and TCA Request Web App. Deployed apps/APIs on AWS for scalability and reliability.

Designed and developed the Sophos portal to support business operations. Built and maintained responsive and user-friendly interfaces, optimized performance, and ensured compatibility across devices and browsers.
Designed and developed the front-end of the Bank Admin Console for the Philus client. Ensured a seamless and intuitive user experience for administrators managing bank operations.

experience.project: Survey App and Admin Web Project
experience.overview: Developed and maintained web and mobile interfaces for the Admin Console and Reward System, ensuring high usability and performance. Collaborated with cross-functional teams for seamless integration and alignment with business objectives. Optimized for responsiveness and performance across devices and platforms.
Designed and developed a user-friendly and responsive web application for managing bank admin tasks. Collaborated with back-end developer to ensure applications meet business requirements.
